generator_linkage: One byte-identical program and shared model specification; only parameters.active_context changes between frozen child specifications. Context distributions and assumptions are authored by the scientific Agent.

status_policy.computable: approximate, with actual assumption IDs and the exact listed operator
status_policy.unsupported: not_computable, null operator, retained ID and explicit substantive reason
status_policy.source_estimator: unweighted Monte Carlo sample statistics approximate published source projections; Pani survey estimator is not reconstructed
status_policy.full_source_population_selection: Source population exclusions are part of the Agent-authored context construction and assumptions; empty operator selection means the full declared source context.
status_policy.source_age_support: Agent declares and justifies source supports; target age bounds and quotas do not automatically apply to source contexts. Pani >=70 is not truncated at 79 by this panel.
status_policy.budget: One initial source run per computable context; at most one final source run after the single scientific revision. Retention reuses exact outputs. No adaptive extra draws.

grouping_interpretation: Historical pending labels in these unchanged normalized records are superseded by the separate root admission. Original/derived alternate representations are not independent evidence. Quarantine and contextual restrictions persist.
restrictions: Jansen source regression sex coding remains unknown; the rounded male/female marginal does not resolve it.
Jansen Table3 II/III remains quarantined; extra erythrocyte/lifestyle covariates cannot be deleted to construct another model.
Liu univariate equation remains contextual, not a numeric calibration constraint.
Pani and Liu NHANES source years overlap; no independent replication claim.
Pani Table1 SEs remain survey SEs; no SE times sqrt(n) conversion.
Jansen Table2 reported interval confidence level remains unknown; no invented standard error.
NGSP unit guidance and conventional glucose factor18.0 do not establish serum/plasma equivalence.
